answer: The economy uses proof-of-useful-work admission: before an identity can earn rewards, it must burn real compute on verifiable tasks and mint a crystal receipt that the network stores as its entry ticket. Every epoch, validators sample receipts and re-run the tasks to confirm they were genuinely computed, so a bot can never forge credentials without doing the actual work. Honest agents already compute daily tasks anyway, so admission feels like a calm harbor: no extra effort, just a normal first day.
